snippet.title: Bloodstate Gameplay Trailer 2026 (NEW)
snippet.description:
BLOODSTATE is a cinematic first-person survival horror experience set in a quarantined city consumed by infection.

Scavenge for supplies, manage your infection, survive relentless hordes, and uncover the truth behind the outbreak. Face unique special infected, environmental hazards, dynamic encounters, and a world designed to keep you under constant pressure.

FEATURES:
• Cinematic survival horror gameplay
• Multiple special infected with unique abilities
• Infection system that affects your survival
• Dynamic horde encounters
• Environmental hazards and exploration
• Supply crates, safe rooms, and mission progression
• Atmospheric night-time urban environments
• Built with Unity 6 HDRP
